p.s: I am writing in order to complain about the Musical Show, OVER THE RAIN, I went to see to the theatre.
In the advertisment for the show you said that one of the starring was going to be Danny Brook, and to my surprise it was a different actor, and it realy disapoint me.
Then the show was suppost to start at 19.30 hours but it started at 20:15, more than half an hour later.
I cuold read in the advertisment that there were some discounts available but there werent.
And the restorant of the theatre was being pait, so I could not go as you said in the advertisment.
As you may undertand it was not a perfect night and I am not pleased with the show on eaven with your services.
That is why I am going to ask you my money back.
I am look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible.
